newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES DROP TO END AT 19 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES DROP TO END AT 19 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates dropped more than one percentage point in ample liquidity, traders said on Tuesday.
Overnight rates closed at 19 percent, down from Monday's 20.0625 percent and traders added it was unclear which direction rates would take on Wednesday.

"If the major banks put their money into the (central bank's) one-week reverse repo, the fall could stop or even be reversed, but if they don't, the rates could even slip below today's level," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
